english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an accusation or allegation, including the act of making one.
This is the all-purpose choice when the allegation is an accusation made against someone.

examples.english: They made a serious accusation against the company.
examples.traditional: 佢對公司作出嚴重指控。
